I had an appointment in advance, but:

I was suspicious after waiting for an hour, but I didn't want to disrupt their work, so I let the queue run its course. Now I'm worried about whether my treatment will receive adequate attention. I've already paid one installment, and my teeth aren't very complicated, just slightly crooked from not wearing my retainer.
I'll probably continue treatment here, but this review will hopefully be helpful for anyone who is hesitant.
